evidence.quote: `` It Ai n't Me '' is a song by Norwegian DJ Kygo and American singer Selena Gomez
It was released by Interscope Records , Sony and Ultra on 17 February 2017
It was released by Interscope Records , Sony and Ultra on 17 February 2017 as the lead single from Kygo 's first EP , Stargazing
The song was written by Kygo , Gomez , Andrew Watt , Brian Lee and Ali Tamposi
It was produced by Kygo , Watt , Ben Rice and Louis Bell
A dance - pop , electropop and tropical house song
comprises an acoustic guitar line
a build - drop arrangement in its chorus
in its chorus featuring pulsing piano notes , bass , synthesizers , finger - snap claps and pan flute melodies
Gomez sings the track in a husky tone
while in the chorus her vocals are reduced to recurring syllables
